# Caddy — servlet-mapping-sse

App at / with the Vaadin servlet on /ui/*, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. The Hilla rule still strips /ui, but Hilla push cannot work at all over SSE: FluxConnection is WebSocket-only with no fallback.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Caddy site block (`caddy/http/servlet-mapping-sse/vaadin.caddyfile`), mounted as
`/etc/caddy/vaadin.caddyfile`:

```caddyfile
# App at / with the Vaadin servlet on /ui/*, PUSH over Server-Sent Events.
#
# templates/servlet-mapping.caddyfile plus the refusal from
# templates/passthrough-sse.caddyfile. The Hilla rule still strips /ui so the
# browser-callables under /connect keep working, but Hilla push cannot work at
# all here: FluxConnection is WebSocket-only with no fallback, and the upgrade
# it asks for is the one this proxy refuses.
:80 {
	import common

	@upgrade header Upgrade *
	respond @upgrade 501

	@hilla path /ui/HILLA/* /ui/connect/*
	uri @hilla strip_prefix /ui

	reverse_proxy vaadin:8080
}
```

The global options and the `common` snippet this file imports (the
access log and the compression allowlist) come from the shared
[Caddyfile](../../Caddyfile), mounted read-only over the image's own
`/etc/caddy/Caddyfile`. It imports this file, so the two only load as a pair.
